annotations.title: Check Store Trust and Readiness Score

description: Retrieve a previously scored independent store or Shopify storefront by domain: agent-readiness, trust signals, structured data, and review system. Use this first for an existing store score; it is read-only and does not crawl. If not scored yet, use `scan_store` for an explicit fresh scan. For a retailer product listing rather than a storefront, use `check_product_trust`.
name: check_store_score
title: Check Store Trust and Readiness Score
